posts.linkedinTagged:
Owner. Buyer. Cashier. Manager.

When you wear every hat, buying is one more job on your plate.

The idea behind BUY HARD is a buyer you can talk to like another member of your team: tell it what matters, discuss the buying decision, and keep approval of the spend.

This is how I want it to feel. The app footage shows the current sample, not a live supplier purchase.

Which recurring purchase would you hand over first?

posts.linkedinTagged:
I got my first buying experience in my parents' restaurant. Then I opened a couple of my own.

Ingredients from the local market. Compostable cups from a specialty store. The usual online orders. Buying happens everywhere.

That experience is part of why I'm building BUY HARD. But your business will have details I haven't thought of.

I'd love to hear them. Bring one recurring item, the supplier you use, and the part of buying it that takes too much of your time.

We'll look at it together in a 20-minute walkthrough. The app screen in this video uses sample data.

Tell me what you need:
